description: This file defines a React component named MessageList that renders a list of chat messages with markdown-like formatting and manages scrolling to show new messages. It also includes a minimal markdown renderer supporting bold, inline code, fenced code blocks, and a typing indicator.

methods.name: renderMarkdown(text)
methods.description: Renders a string with markdown-like syntax into React elements, supporting fenced code blocks, bold text, and inline code.

methods.name: MessageList({ messages, typing })
methods.description: Main React component that renders a list of messages, manages auto-scrolling, and displays typing indicator.
